status: implementation contract after Astra source review; not a passed test or independent holdout

frozenParent.interpretation: The parent's source facts and historical observation remain frozen. This supplement defines reading acceptance only; it does not turn the parent's requested approved member sets into proven accounting outcomes.

purpose.scopeOrigin: explicit operator/test scope confirmation, not inferred from both frozen files

coordinates.excelAddresses: A1 notation; original sheet, never renumbered after exclusion
coordinates.sourceIdentity: file SHA-256 plus sheet index plus physical row; source order and row numbers are preserved

paymentPair.automaticApproval: permitted only if the unchanged unique exact-reference signed-amount date and conflict checks pass after header provenance is proved

creditNotePair.knownGap: Current strong-reference guards require at least four normalized characters. Any change to short-reference approval is a separate Astra decision.

firstVersionVocabulary.childLabels: Existing unambiguous Debit/Dr/مدين and Credit/Cr/دائن header vocabulary, including only consistent bilingual parts and compatible explicit currency tags
firstVersionVocabulary.otherParentLabels: Remain unavailable to this two-row inference rule until separately specified; never guessed from numerical values

provenanceContract.nativeSource: XLSX merge geometry recorded by io from the original workbook
requiredValidation: bounded integer coordinates within source dimensions
anchor at the top-left of each declared merge
header merges end within the two-row band
vertical inherited labels stay in a single column
both header rows and all anchors are visible and safe
formulas, unsafe formatting and non-merge issues remain disqualifying
amount child labels have a single compatible monetary parent
no contradictory or duplicate candidate role is resolved using data values
provenanceContract.authority: Evidence is re-derived and checked from the native source. A saved mapping, client payload, AI proposal or exported workbook cannot grant itself this authority.
provenanceContract.replay: Carry and validate native geometry through worker, source replay and session restoration; re-read original bytes when provenance is missing or inconsistent, or leave inference unavailable.
provenanceContract.derivedView: One shared immutable derived header view with labels and origin coordinates; do not replace or patch source rows.
provenanceContract.reuse: Derive geometry and validate it once per native read/replay, then reuse the immutable view bound to source hash, sheet and header selection. Do not parse the workbook again per row or per consumer. Invalidate when any binding changes.
provenanceContract.issuePolicy: Preserve every original cellIssue. A proven header view may distinguish an expected header merge from a disqualifying issue for that label only; it may not clear issues on source rows or on transaction cells.
provenanceContract.fallback: Unavailable or ambiguous header inference keeps the file available for manual column review and partial useful processing under existing safety rules. It is not a blanket file rejection and it is not approval of the ambiguous data.

testMatrix.mutation: Original positive F02 workbook with native merges and safe literal anchors
testMatrix.expectedDecision: unique Statement table with mapping and source facts specified above

testMatrix.mutation: Reorder columns and rename sheets while preserving roles, native merge geometry, amounts and original physical identities
testMatrix.expectedDecision: derive mapping from labels and geometry, not sheet name or fixed column positions

testMatrix.mutation: Replace safe labels with explicit Arabic equivalents or bilingual labels whose every part names the same field
testMatrix.expectedDecision: equivalent role mapping; an unsupported label remains manual review rather than guessed
requires: no reference normalization used as role proof

testMatrix.mutation: Extend a header merge into the first movement row
testMatrix.expectedDecision: manual review; first movement remains visible and may not be excluded as a header
requires: no global file refusal solely for inference

testMatrix.mutation: Merge horizontally across Date and Document No, or declare intersecting/contradictory header ranges
testMatrix.expectedDecision: no assignment of one shared label to distinct roles; re-read malformed provenance or request manual mapping

testMatrix.mutation: Remove native merge evidence while leaving adjacent partial header-looking rows
testMatrix.expectedDecision: do not compose the two rows without provenance; a separately complete ordinary header may still use existing rules
requires: no inferred geometry from empty cells

testMatrix.mutation: Hide either header row or a required anchor/column
testMatrix.expectedDecision: keep source and visibility issue available for manual review; hidden labels cannot grant automatic header evidence

testMatrix.mutation: Use a formula, error, unsafe text format or another non-merge issue in a required anchor
testMatrix.expectedDecision: retain the issue; no merge exemption for the unsafe label

testMatrix.mutation: Use Quantity/Count as parent, or conflicting currencies/roles across a parent and child label
testMatrix.expectedDecision: do not treat numeric-looking values as proof of monetary meaning

testMatrix.mutation: Duplicate Debit or Credit children, omit a child, or place an additional competing amount role in the same band
testMatrix.expectedDecision: keep the competing roles visible; no first-column or amount-value tie-break

testMatrix.mutation: Place a plausible unresolved transaction table before a later valid F02 band, or add a second plausible source sheet
testMatrix.expectedDecision: preserve the first-table barrier and request sheet/table choice; never skip earlier movements

testMatrix.mutation: Apply the frozen negative variant with INV-934 and PO-99 but unchanged 780+220 total
testMatrix.expectedDecision: read all four supplier rows; prohibit every conflictingInvoice member set
requires: correct totals do not prove identity

testMatrix.mutation: Add an excluded, erroneous or repeated source row carrying a candidate document/payment identity
testMatrix.expectedDecision: existing completeness and competing-identity guards govern matching; no apparent uniqueness obtained by dropping the row
requires: affected automatic matches blocked when evidence is incomplete

testMatrix.mutation: Change a movement sign or explicit currency, or introduce a balance arithmetic disagreement
testMatrix.expectedDecision: existing sign/currency/balance checks surface the issue and limit affected claims; header proof never repairs the numbers
requires: unaffected usable data retained where permitted

testMatrix.mutation: Keep original CN-3, absent supplier Type, Line ID, and mixed PO / Bank reference header
testMatrix.expectedDecision: do not infer Invoice/Payment/Credit Note from prefixes, assign mixed reference a bank role, or bypass short-reference policy

testMatrix.mutation: Change claimed file hash, sheet, merge range, anchor label, header index or native provenance during worker/session/export replay
testMatrix.expectedDecision: reject the stale/forged header claim, re-read available original bytes and recompute; otherwise keep manual review available
requires: header evidence displayed and exported matches the recomputation
no automatic match from an unverified claim

solCycle4Acceptance: Parent contract, frozen sources and historical baseline are byte-identical.
Native provenance is typed, runtime-validated and re-derived across direct, worker and restored-session paths.
All header-dependent consumers use the same derived view; original rows and issues remain untouched.
R01 and R12 pass readingAcceptance and matchingBoundary; applicable matrix cases have explicit expected-outcome tests.
Independent source-fact checking verifies signed minor units, row membership and opening/closing exclusion before product result checking.
A browser upload/reconcile/review/export run verifies source coordinates, row fates and evidence in the actual downloadable workbook.
Existing required type, test, mutation, build and browser checks pass; no general accuracy percentage is inferred from F02.
Observed failures and unsupported cases are reported separately; no amount of safe refusal counts as successful reading.
Astra reviews the exact implementation diff and evidence before merging a product release.
astraReviewTriggers: Any new automatic match or altered identity/group/type/short-reference policy beyond unchanged rules consuming valid header evidence.
Any new acceptance of mixed-role reference headers, inferred document types, bank claims or amount subsets.
Any exception to formula, hidden-cell, unsafe-format, malformed-provenance or source-completeness guards.
Any design that rewrites original rows, deletes issues, trusts replayed certificates, or reads derived labels differently between consumers.
Any expansion beyond the bounded two-row native XLSX header family or any changed scope/full-reconciliation claim.
Final review before production merge, even when no other trigger occurred.
